title: Process.
bodyText: Citations, orders of notice, and all other process issuing from the court shall bear teste of the judge, and be under the seal of the court and signed by the registrar.
bodyHtml: §501-4  Process.  Citations, orders of notice, and all other process issuing from the court shall bear teste of the judge, and be under the seal of the court and signed by the registrar. [L 1903, c 56, §5; am imp L 1913, c 21, §1; RL 1925, §3194; RL 1935, §5003; RL 1945, §12603; RL 1955, §342-4; HRS §501-4]
